title: Less searching. More playing.
summary: A more compact homepage, clearer guide cards and a player title that stays above the game.
changes: Homepage shortcuts and featured guides now use tighter layouts and a wider variety of Pokémon artwork.
Guide cards use one cover image, with three cards across on desktop.
The Play page keeps its title visible after the game launches.
Rankings now show saved official survival records for Solo and Group across four periods.

title: Original animations and clearer card choices
summary: Original collection animations and shiny effects accompany a move library organized by partner.
changes: The Level-up page lets you choose from all 966 partners and inspect their move pools.
Boss rewards, held items and Bond explanations are grouped alongside the upgrade cards.
The Tier List Maker supports dragging between rows and scrolling during a drag.
Builds and Sources were retired; guide and card links lead to the remaining pages.
